description: Ground truth for the Customer Returns scenario (core evaluation tier).

smoke_prompts.prompt: I bought a ProBlend 500 blender last month and it broke after a few uses. My order number is ORD-1001.
I bought some headphones about six weeks ago. Order ORD-1002. I just don't like them anymore, I want a refund.
I received a kitchen scale as a gift and I'd like to return it. I don't have an order number but the serial number on the box is SN-KTCH-780-C103.
I was charged twice for my order ORD-1004. I need a refund for the duplicate charge.

CR-001.description: Within-warranty defect — ProBlend 500 blender broke after 3 uses
CR-001.symptom: Customer reports blender broke after a few uses; purchased 14 days ago.
red_herrings: ORD-1005 / SN-BLND-PRO-A101: Alice also has a warranty for a ProBlend PRO (different SKU). Agent must not apply this warranty to ORD-1001.

CR-002.description: Outside 30-day window, no defect — headphones return denied
CR-002.symptom: Customer no longer wants headphones; purchased 46 days ago, outside 30-day window.
CR-002.notes: Flow's ineligible_result path should be triggered, not the approval form. Not verifiable via smoke prompt alone (CLI cannot observe flow branching).

CR-003.description: Gift return via serial number — kitchen scale eligible for store credit
CR-003.symptom: Customer received product as a gift, has no order ID, provides serial number SN-KTCH-780-C103.

CR-004.description: Billing dispute — duplicate charge, out of scope, must escalate
CR-004.symptom: Customer reports duplicate charge; this is a billing issue, not a product return.
CR-004.notes: Agent must decline to process a return and direct customer to the Billing team. No flow should be triggered.
